style.vernacular: Dense high-rise city of cream and white tile-clad or rendered 1990s-2000s residential slabs and towers with air-conditioner boxes, glass-and-metal skyscrapers in Pudong and Puxi, and surviving lilong (shikumen) lanes of grey and red brick two- and three-storey houses with tiled pitched roofs. Colonial-era Bund and Nanjing Road blocks are stone-faced Art Deco and neoclassical, five to ten storeys. Street trees are plane and camphor.
style.ornament: Shikumen stone-framed gateways with black-lacquered doors and brick walls in red and grey; Art Deco stone fronts on Nanjing Road and the Bund; upturned-eave temple roofs; Jiangnan garden whitewashed walls with grey-tile roofs, moon gates and lattice windows; neon signboards on commercial streets.

sources.what: shikumen: load-bearing brick walls, stone gate frames, black lacquered doors, red-brick developments, 2-3 storeys
